general_information.significance: World's most important sugar crop; plays a vital role in Indian economy. Largest processing industry in India next to cotton.
general_information.employment: Employs nearly 35 million growers & 3,30,000 skilled personnel.
general_information.industry_stats: About 550 sugar factories in India with 135 milling days.
general_information.distribution_global: India, Brazil, Cuba, Mexico, Pakistan, China, Philippines, Thailand
general_information.distribution_india: UP, TN, Maharashtra, Karnataka. UP stands first with 50% area and 40% production. TN stands first in yield.

industrial_processing_and_byproducts.standard_yield: 100t of cane produces 10t sugar + 4t molasses + 3t filter mud + 0.3t ash + 30t bagasse
industrial_processing_and_byproducts.bagasse: Used as fuel, for making fibre boards and paper (7t bagasse = 1t paper).
industrial_processing_and_byproducts.molasses: Used in distilleries for ethyl alcohol (ethanol), blended with petrol (Gasohol). Used for oxalic, maleic, and citric acid, Rum, and livestock feed additive.
industrial_processing_and_byproducts.press_mud: Rich in organic 'C', 'P', & 'S'; used in vermicomposting as manure.
industrial_processing_and_byproducts.co_generation: A plant of 2500 TCD generates 7-8 MW surplus power.

cultivated_species.characteristics: Thick and juicy cane, good for chewing, indigenous to New Guinea. High sugar %, low fibre, high tonnage. Generally resistant to smut but susceptible to red rot. Tropical areas.
Indigenous to N-E India, long thin stalks, broad leaves, low/medium sucrose, early maturity. Zig-zag internodes with prominent nodes.
Indigenous to N-E India, short thin stalks, narrow leaves, low/medium sucrose, early maturing.

botany_and_growth.plant_type: Perennial grass growing in tropical regions.
botany_and_growth.morphology: 3-4 m height, tillering, unbranching stalk (cane). Stalk has distinct nodes and internodes coated with waxy material. Eye bud at each node protected by leaf sheath.
botany_and_growth.tillering: Produces 20-40 tillers per cane from below soil surface.
botany_and_growth.inflorescence: Called 'arrow', has male and female parts. Produced at 10-12 months (qualitative short day plant).

root_system.sett_roots: Temporary roots from root primordia at the base of every cane joint; provide initial moisture and nutrients.
root_system.shoot_roots: Permanent, thick fleshy white roots from lower nodes of the primary shoot; provide anchorage.

botany_and_growth.flowering_disadvantages: Reduces quality (1% Sucrose loss), pithy canes, loss of apical dominance, development of water shoots, shorter leaf blade, low yield (25% loss), high fibre, reduced juice extraction.
botany_and_growth.flowering_control: Withholding water, mechanical defoliation, chemical sprays (Maleic hydrazide - MH, ethephon).
botany_and_growth.nobilization: Crossing wild cane S. spontaneum with S. officinarum, with backcrossing to the noble parent to get thick stalks of good quality.

climate_and_soil.climate: Tropical to subtropical. Optimum temperature: 21-35°C (Growth arrests if <20°C or >50°C). Cold stress below 12°C.
climate_and_soil.rainfall: Well distributed annual rainfall of 750-1200 mm is optimum. Total water requirement: 1200-1500 mm.
climate_and_soil.sunshine: Bright sunshine leads to thicker, shorter stems and broader greener leaves. Low sunshine leads to slender, long stems with narrow yellowish leaves.
climate_and_soil.day_length: Short day length decreases tillers and tonnage. Long day produces more dry matter.

soil_requirements.soil_type: Deep red soil, Black soil; well-drained loamy soils are ideal (ಆಳವಾದ ಕೆಂಪು ಮಣ್ಣು, ಕಪ್ಪು ಮಣ್ಣು).
soil_requirements.drainage: Essential — water should not stagnate (ಅತ್ಯಗತ್ಯ — ನೀರು ನಿಲ್ಲಬಾರದು)
soil_requirements.notes: Saline and alkaline soils are not suitable.

recommended_varieties.notes: More yield and sugar content, very popular among farmers.

varieties_and_seasons.notes: In coastal areas, Nov to Feb planting can be done.
varietal_decline_causes: Lack of aeration/reduced oxygen due to compactness
Pest and diseases (Ratoon stunt disease, mosaic, nematodes, red rot)
varieties_and_seasons.varietal_decline_management: Replacement of varieties, heat therapy before planting, good agronomic management.

key_variety_characteristics_tnau.Co 86032: Universal performer, multi-ratooning, self-detrashing, high sugar recovery.
key_variety_characteristics_tnau.CoV 92102: Non-flowering, thrives in red, clay, and alkaline soils.
key_variety_characteristics_tnau.CoC 90063: Non-lodging, drought and alkaline tolerant, excellent ratooner.
key_variety_characteristics_tnau.Co 85019: Drought tolerant and resistant to Red Rot disease.
key_variety_characteristics_tnau.TNAU SC Si 8: Tolerant to drought and waterlogging; ideal for mechanized cultivation.

acre_basis.notes: Select disease-free setts from an 8-10 month old healthy nursery crop. For wide row spacing, 7,000-8,000 setts are sufficient.

imperial_units.notes: For wide row spacing (5-6 ft), plant setts in a zig-zag pattern on both sides of the furrow. This saves 20% on seed material and allows easy inter-cropping.

metric_units.paired_row: 60-120-60 X 30 cm pair (60 cm two rows, 120 cm gap)

spacing.paired_row: 60-120-60 X 30 cm pair (60 cm two rows, 120 cm gap)

land_preparation.process: 30-40 cm deep ploughing (ಆಳವಾದ ಉಳುಮೆ) followed by two cross harrowings to make the soil smooth.
land_preparation.manure: Apply 8-10 tonnes of Farmyard Manure (FYM) or Compost per acre before planting.

planting_methods.details: 15-20 cm deep furrows across slope at 90 cm spacing. Setts placed with buds facing sideward and covered with soil. In ridges/furrows, setts planted half way through ridge.
Shallow furrows 8-10 cm depth at 90 cm apart. 3 eye budded setts planted at 30 cm distance. Covered by running wooden plank and irrigated by flooding.
Trenches 2-3 m long, 25-30 cm deep, 40 cm wide at 90 cm spacing. Suitable for coastal areas (prevents lodging) and stiff clays/sloppy lands.
Square pits 40-60 cm dug at 90 cm apart. Trenches dug after every 3 rows to store water. Suitable for low rainfall areas. Two setts planted per pit (>5 cm depth).
90 cm row spacing with 30 cm plant spacing. 120 cm gap can be used for mechanized farming or intercropping.

seed_treatment.details: Dip the sugarcane setts in a 0.1% Carbendazim 50 WP solution (1 g/L water) for 10-15 minutes before planting to prevent Pineapple disease (ಅನಾನಸ್ ರೋಗ) and soil-borne fungal infections.
Treat setts in moist hot air/water at 52°C for 1 hour to eliminate internal viruses and smut before nursery planting.

application_schedule.notes: Apply 10 tons of FYM/Compost 2-3 weeks before planting. Apply 10% N, full P, and full K in the furrows at planting.
Apply the final 40% of the Nitrogen dose during inter-cultivation and earth up the soil.

application_schedule_detailed.notes: Apply 10 tons of FYM/Compost 2-3 weeks before planting. Apply 10% N, full P, and full K in the furrows at planting.
Apply the final 40% of the Nitrogen dose during inter-cultivation and earth up the soil.

application_schedule_general.notes: Apply 25 t/ha FYM. Apply 10% nitrogen and full P&K.
Remaining nitrogen should be given in 3 split doses on the 6th, 10th, and 14th week.

nutrient_specifics.high_nitrogen_effects: Increases pest and disease problem, pithyness, delays ripening, reduces juice quality and sugar recovery, increases water/non-milleable shoots.
nutrient_specifics.silicon_importance: Sugarcane is siliciferous. Silicon maintains turgidity, reduces lodging, ensures better water utilization, provides resistance to pest/diseases, and improves sugar recovery. Calcium-magnesium silicate can be used.

micronutrients_and_biofertilizers.notes: Mix Azotobacter/Azospirillum (1kg) and PSB like Bacillus megaterium (4kg) with FYM and apply to the soil.

micronutrients_and_biofertilizers.dosage: Azotobacter 2.5 kg/ha, Bacillus megaterium, Agrobacterium radiobacter, Aspergillus awamorii: 10 kg/ha

irrigation_schedule.notes: Irrigate once every 8 days in sandy loam soils and once every 15 days in black soils. In summer, apply 3 tons of sugarcane trash mulch per acre to conserve moisture.
Irrigate once in 8 days in red sandy soils and once in 15 days in black soils. Total water requirement is 250 cm. Less water first 3 months, more water later.

irrigation_schedule.stop_before_harvest: Stop irrigation 30 days before harvest to increase sugar content.

irrigation_schedule.notes: Tillering & grand growth stages are highly critical for irrigation.

weed_management.chemical: Atrazine 50 WP OR Metribuzin 70 WP OR Diuron 80 WP
weed_management.chemical_kannada: ಅಟ್ರಾಜಿನ್ 50 ಡಬ್ಲ್ಯೂ.ಪಿ ಅಥವಾ ಮೆಟ್ರಿಬುಜಿನ್ 70 ಡಬ್ಲ್ಯೂ.ಪಿ ಅಥವಾ ಡೈಯುರಾನ್ 80 ಡಬ್ಲ್ಯೂ.ಪಿ

weed_management.notes: Spray at 25 days after planting to control broad-leaved weeds and sedges.

weed_management.weeds_targeted: Sorghum halepense, Cynodon dactylon, Ipomoea spp., Cyperus rotundus
weed_management.dosage: 2.5 kg Atrazine OR 2.5 kg Diuron OR 1.5 kg Metribuzin in 750 litres
weed_management.notes: Pre-emergent application. Manual hoeing after 2-3 weeks of planting gives better control.
Hand weeding (ಕೈಯಿಂದ ಕಳೆ ತೆಗೆಯುವಿಕೆ) is essential for 30-40% yield increase. Mulching also helps.

pest_management.name: Early Shoot Borer (ಆದಿ ಸುಳಿ ಕೊರೆಯುವ ಹುಳು)

recommendations.notes: Spray using 300L water/acre when shoots start drying up.
Release Trichogramma chilonis egg parasitoids starting from the 4th week of planting, once a week for 5 weeks.
Release 90 days after planting, once a week for 5 weeks. Collect and destroy egg masses.
Apply granular insecticide at the time of planting or at 60 days to prevent roots/setts from being eaten.
Strip dry leaves and spray using 300L water/acre. For bio-control, release Micromus igorotus predators (500-1000/acre).
Apply in the furrows at 45 days. Survey every 15 days (15 ದಿನಕ್ಕೊಮ್ಮೆ ಸಮೀಕ್ಷೆ).
Mandatory 15-minute sett dip before planting. Prevents setts from rotting and smelling like ripe pineapple.

recommendations.chemical: Copper Oxychloride 50 WP OR Mancozeb 75 WP
recommendations.notes: Spray using 300L water/acre when long brown/red spots appear. Grow resistant varieties like Co 62175.
Uproot and burn infected plants. Use tissue-cultured disease-free seedlings for planting.
Uproot and burn clumps producing the long, black whip-like smut structure instead of a normal shoot.

disease_management.name: Wilt / Grassy Shoot / Red Rot (ಕೆಂಪು ಕೊಳೆ / ಸಸಿ ಕುಂಠಿತ)

recommendations.notes: Pre-treatment with Carbendazim 0.1% for 10 min is crucial. Rotate crops (ಬೆಳೆ ಪರಿವರ್ತನೆ).

intercultivation_and_cropping_systems.earthing_up: Done after last top dressing of nitrogen and after each top dressing to give support to the main plant and tillers.
intercultivation_and_cropping_systems.wrapping_and_propping: Wrapping: Tying stalks of same clump with lower/dried leaves. Propping: Giving support with bamboo or tying wrapped canes to adjacent rows.
intercultivation_and_cropping_systems.intercropping: French bean & soybean (Variety: KB-79) or pulse/legumes.
intercultivation_and_cropping_systems.sequenced_crops: Potato, Rice, Wheat, Cotton, Sorghum, Chickpea, Groundnut.

harvesting_and_seed_production.maturity_indicators: 12-14 months after planting. Withered lower leaves & few green leaves at top, metallic sound of stem, hand refractometer reading (Brix) between 18-20.
harvesting_and_seed_production.harvesting_method: Manual cutting at ground level (ನೆಲಮಟ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಕತ್ತರಿಸುವುದು). Detrashing and cutting the green top. Transport to factory within 24 hours to prevent sucrose loss.
harvesting_and_seed_production.seed_cane_production: Seed cane should be free from pests/diseases, high in moisture, rich in invert sugars/soluble nitrogen. Top 2/3rd portion is suitable due to apical dominance.

ratooning.definition: Allowing the stubble to regrow after the harvest of the main crop.
ratooning.advantages: Shorter crop cycle, reduces seed cost (25-30%), better utilization of climate.
ratooning.disadvantages: Lower yields due to poor sprouting/soil compaction, build-up of pests/diseases, early run-out of commercial varieties.

management_practices.trash_burning: Advised if plant crop is infested with scales/mealy bugs, termites, rodents, or excess moisture affecting sprouting.
management_practices.stubble_shaving: Cutting protruding stubbles to ground level with a spade to facilitate healthy underground bud sprouting and deep root system.
management_practices.off_barring: Breaking/cutting ridges on either side to loosen soil between rows, reducing compaction and aiding root development.
management_practices.gap_filling: Crucial if gaps >20%. Done using pre-germinated single eye bud setts or excess sprouts. Fill gaps with new seedlings.
management_practices.fertilizer_management: Entire P and 1/3 N&K applied soon after stubble shaving. 25% extra Nitrogen is recommended for ratoon crops.
management_practices.yield_notes: Ratoon yield is typically 15-20% lower than main crop. Recommended for maximum 2 cycles (ಎರಡನೇ ರಾಟೂನ್ ಗಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಬೇಡ).

fibre_cane.description: Bred for fibre or bagasse for paper industries. Less sugar, high biomass, more tillers.
fibre_cane.varieties: S. robustum varieties Co-421, Co-423, Co-426

energy_cane.description: Bred for high molasses production for bio-fuel. Grown with closer spacing & high nitrogen. High biomass and total sugars.

types: High Fructose Corn Syrup (HFCS) - replaces sugar up to 10% in soft drinks.

intercropping_details.title: ಮಿಶ್ರ ಬೆಳೆ (Intercropping)
intercropping_details.content: ಕಬ್ಬಿನ ಜೊತೆ ಮಿಶ್ರ ಬೆಳೆ ಮಾಡುವುದರಿಂದ ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ಆದಾಯ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಮಣ್ಣಿನ ಫಲವತ್ತತೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತದೆ. ಸೂಕ್ತ ಮಿಶ್ರ ಬೆಳೆಗಳೆಂದರೆ ಈರುಳ್ಳಿ, ಆಲೂಗೆಡ್ಡೆ, ಕೊತ್ತಂಬರಿ, ಮೆಂತ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಅವರೆಕಾಳು. ಕಬ್ಬಿನ ಆರಂಭಿಕ 3 ತಿಂಗಳು ಮಿಶ್ರ ಬೆಳೆ ಬೆಳೆಯಲು ಸೂಕ್ತ ಸಮಯ. ದ್ವಿದಳ ಧಾನ್ಯ ಬೆಳೆ ಮಿಶ್ರ ಮಾಡಿದರೆ ಮಣ್ಣಿನ ಸಾರಜನಕ ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತದೆ. ಮಿಶ್ರ ಬೆಳೆ ಕಬ್ಬಿನ ಮುಖ್ಯ ಬೆಳೆಗೆ ಸ್ಪರ್ಧೆ ನೀಡಬಾರದು.

benefits.soil: Legumes fix nitrogen in the soil.

schemes.name: PM-KISAN
schemes.description: Annual direct benefit transfer to farmers.

schemes.name: Drip Irrigation Subsidy
schemes.description: Financial aid for installing drip systems.

services.soil_test: Free soil test at Raita Samparka Kendra (ರೈತ ಸಂಪರ್ಕ ಕೇಂದ್ರ)
services.price_control: FRP (Fair and Remunerative Price) decided by Central Government

seasonal_risks.monsoon: Drainage is crucial; risk of root rot.
seasonal_risks.summer: Increase irrigation intervals; use trash mulch.
seasonal_risks.hailstorm: Spray fungicide immediately if hailstorms occur.
